timeline.text: A driving guide narrates places you pass — but a spot that got a short, thin story early on stayed that way forever, even on roads you drive nightly.
Now it checks which places you've actually driven past most in the last three weeks, and rewrites those first.
It also matches Wikidata place names smarter, so the same farm spelled two ways on two maps stops duplicating.
Your most-driven roads now get up to 10 sentences instead of 6.
